documents.text:
Hello,
our framework agreement ctr:4600070640 for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 (part:360020) expires on 30 June 2027. We would like to agree the terms for the coming period and will send our offer when we meet. Please let us know your expected volumes.
Best regards,
Kugellager-Vertrieb Inntal GmbH

persona.summary: Austrian family bearing distributor (37 M EUR); we are 0.27 %. It lost a large distribution contract (Oct 2026) and its second shift has been idle since spring, so it needs volume, though it is reviewing small accounts. Already cheaper than 70620 on 6306/6308, so our lever is moving 70620's quota (70 % of 6306) to it. Historically asks ~4 % and keeps only 27 %. Moves above 2 % need its pricing committee. Offer binding volume plus quota shift for a lower price.
persona.notes: Needs work: lost a large distribution contract and its second shift is idle; it is also reviewing small accounts like ours, so volume is the key. Renewal mail (contract to 2027-06) asks our expected volumes. OTD 81-87 % vs 95 % target, ppm 0 in Q3.

tactics: Open deep and offer to move 70620's share of 6306/6308 to it in exchange for a lower price.
State a binding annual volume and send the volume schedule it asked for in its renewal mail.
Cite the scorecard once: OTD 81-87 % against a 95 % target.
Expect steps of about 2 % (pricing-committee threshold); keep moving visibly each round.
